svg.title: TSN funding, accounting and planned network fees
svg.desc: Current Solana deposit and private-credit accounting boundaries, plus planned lower-fee EVM integration cost requirements.

g.text: FUNDING, PRIVATE CREDIT AND AGGREGATE ACCOUNTING
Current experimental Solana flow - future EVM fee policies require separate evidence.
Actual SPL tokens enter TCAP reserve.
PLANNED EVM ROUTES: BASE, ARBITRUM AND POLYGON PoS
Each route needs actual value delivery, source finality, authentication and recovery.
Gas and liquidity costs remain even when sponsored; no universal fee quote is claimed.
Ethereum Layer 1 integration is outside the current low-fee priority.
